package com.danawa.search.analysis.product

import com.danawa.search.analysis.dict.ProductNameDictionary
import com.danawa.search.index.DanawaSearchQueryBuilder
import com.danawa.search.index.FastcatMigrateIndexer
import com.danawa.util.ContextStore
import com.danawa.util.TestUtil
import org.apache.lucene.analysis.TokenStream
import org.apache.lucene.analysis.Tokenizer
import org.elasticsearch.index.query.functionscore.FunctionScoreQueryBuilder
import org.elasticsearch.search.fetch.subphase.highlight.HighlightBuilder
import org.elasticsearch.search.sort.SortBuilder
import org.elasticsearch.xcontent.DeprecationHandler
import org.elasticsearch.xcontent.NamedXContentRegistry
import org.elasticsearch.xcontent.ParseField
import org.elasticsearch.xcontent.json.JsonXContent
import org.elasticsearch.common.logging.Loggers
import org.json.JSONObject
import org.json.JSONWriter
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test
import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream
import java.io.Reader
import java.io.StringReader
import java.io.StringWriter
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets

class ProductNameAnalysisActionTest {

    companion object {
        private val logger = Loggers.getLogger(ProductNameAnalysisActionTest::class.java, "")
        private val contextStore: ContextStore = ContextStore.getStore(AnalysisProductNamePlugin::class.java)

        private const val TEST_QUERY = "" +
            "{ " +
            "  \"query\": { " +
            "    \"function_score\": { " +
            "      \"query\": { " +
            "        \"bool\": { " +
            "          \"must\": [ " +
            "            { " +
            "              \"query_string\": { " +
            "                \"query\": \"*\" " +
            "              } " +
            "            } " +
            "          ], " +
            "          \"filter\": [ " +
            "            { " +
            "              \"term\": { " +
            "                \"DISPYN\": \"Y\" " +
            "              } " +
            "            }, " +
            "            { " +
            "              \"term\": { " +
            "                \"PRICECOMPARISONSTOPYN\": \"N\" " +
            "              } " +
            "            }, " +
            "            { " +
            "              \"term\": { " +
            "                \"CATEGORYDISPYN\": \"Y\" " +
            "              } " +
            "            } " +
            "          ] " +
            "        } " +
            "      }, " +
            "      \"functions\": [ " +
            "        { " +
            "          \"filter\": { " +
            "            \"match\": { " +
            "              \"SHOPPRODUCTCODE\": \"6562693705\" " +
            "            } " +
            "          }, " +
            "          \"weight\": 12 " +
            "        }, " +
            "        { " +
            "          \"filter\": { " +
            "            \"match\": { " +
            "              \"SHOPPRODUCTCODE\": \"P1207582350\" " +
            "            } " +
            "          }, " +
            "          \"weight\": 40 " +
            "        } " +
            "      ], " +
            "      \"boost_mode\": \"sum\" " +
            "    } " +
            "  }, " +
            "  \"sort\": [ " +
            "    { " +
            "      \"_score\": { " +
            "        \"order\": \"desc\" " +
            "      }, " +
            "      \"REGISTERDATE\": { " +
            "        \"order\": \"desc\" " +
            "      } " +
            "    } " +
            "  ] " +
            "} "

        @JvmStatic
        @Throws(Exception::class)
        fun getAnalyzer(
            dictionary: ProductNameDictionary,
            str: String,
            useForQuery: Boolean,
            useSynonym: Boolean,
            useStopword: Boolean,
            useFullString: Boolean
        ): TokenStream {
            val option = AnalyzerOption().apply {
                useForQuery(useForQuery)
                useSynonym(useSynonym)
                useStopword(useStopword)
                useFullString(useFullString)
            }
            val reader: Reader = StringReader(str)
            val tokenizer: Tokenizer = ProductNameTokenizer(dictionary, false)
            tokenizer.setReader(reader)
            return ProductNameAnalysisFilter(tokenizer, dictionary, option)
        }
    }

    @BeforeEach
    fun init() {
        TestUtil.setLogLevel(
            System.getProperty("LOG_LEVEL"),
            ProductNameTokenizer::class.java,
            ProductNameParsingRule::class.java,
            ProductNameAnalysisFilter::class.java
        )
    }

    @Test
    @Throws(Exception::class)
    fun queryBuildTest() {
        if (TestUtil.launchForBuild()) return

        var text = ""
        text = "\uD14C\uC2A4\uD2B8\uC0C1\uD488 ab12cd-12345"
        text = "\uC9D1\uC5C5WAS1836ER27"
        text = "10.5cm"
        text = "LGNOTEBOOK \uD310\uB9E4"
        text = "RF85R901301 \uD310\uB9E4"

        val dictionary = TestUtil.loadDictionary()!!
        val analysis = JSONObject()

        val fields = arrayOf("TOTALINDEX", "BRANDKEYWORD")
        val totalIndex = "TOTALINDEX"
        val boostMap = HashMap<String, Float>()
        boostMap["TOTALINDEX"] = 1.0f
        boostMap["BRANDKEYWORD"] = 100000.0f

        val stream = getAnalyzer(dictionary, text, true, true, true, true)
        val query = DanawaSearchQueryBuilder.buildAnalyzedQuery(stream, fields, totalIndex, boostMap, null, null, analysis, "whitespace")
        logger.debug("Q:{}", query.toString())
        logger.debug("ANALYSIS:{}", analysis)
        assertTrue(true)
    }

    @Test
    @Throws(Exception::class)
    fun queryJSONBuildTest() {
        if (TestUtil.launchForBuild()) return

        var text = ""
        text = "\uD14C\uC2A4\uD2B8\uC0C1\uD488 ab12cd-12345"
        text = "\uC9D1\uC5C5WAS1836ER27"
        text = "10.5cm"
        text = "LGNOTEBOOK \uD310\uB9E4"
        text = "RF85R901301 \uD310\uB9E4"

        val dictionary = TestUtil.loadDictionary()!!

        val fields = "MODELWEIGHT^10000,MAKERKEYWORD^20000,BRANDKEYWORD^300000,CATEGORYWEIGHT^100".split(",".toRegex()).toTypedArray()
        val totalIndex = "TOTALINDEX"
        val boostMap = HashMap<String, Float>()
        boostMap["MODELWEIGHT"] = 1.0f
        boostMap["MAKERKEYWORD"] = 100000.0f
        boostMap["BRANDKEYWORD"] = 100000.0f
        boostMap["CATEGORYWEIGHT"] = 100000.0f

        val stream = getAnalyzer(dictionary, text, true, true, true, true)
        val query = DanawaSearchQueryBuilder.buildAnalyzedJSONQuery(stream, fields, totalIndex, "whitespace")
        logger.debug("Q:{}", query.toString(2))
        assertTrue(true)
    }

    @Test
    @Throws(Exception::class)
    fun queryFromStringTest() {
        if (TestUtil.launchForBuild()) return

        logger.debug("PARSING..")
        var source: String = TEST_QUERY
        val json = JSONObject(source)
        for (key in json.keySet()) {
            logger.debug("KEY:{} / {}", key, json.opt(key).javaClass)
        }
        source = json.optString("query")

        var time = System.nanoTime()
        val query = DanawaSearchQueryBuilder.parseQuery(source)

        val q = query as FunctionScoreQueryBuilder
        time = System.nanoTime() - time
        logger.debug("Q:{}", q.query())
        logger.debug("PARSING TAKES {} ms", (Math.round(time * 100.0 / 1000000.0).toInt()) / 100.0)

        val parser = JsonXContent.jsonXContent.createParser(
            DanawaSearchQueryBuilder.INSTANCE.SEARCH_CONTENT_REGISTRY,
            DeprecationHandler.IGNORE_DEPRECATIONS,
            ByteArrayInputStream(json.optString("query").toByteArray(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
        )
        val token = parser.nextToken()
        logger.debug("TOKEN:{}", token)
    }

    @Test
    @Throws(Exception::class)
    fun sortFromStringTest() {
        if (TestUtil.launchForBuild()) return

        val source = "[{\"REGISTERDATE\":{\"order\":\"desc\"}}]"

        logger.debug("SOURCE:{}", source)
        val entries = ArrayList<NamedXContentRegistry.Entry>()
        val entry = NamedXContentRegistry.Entry(
            List::class.java,
            ParseField("sort")
        ) { p -> SortBuilder.fromXContent(p) }
        entries.add(entry)
        val registry = NamedXContentRegistry(entries)
        val parser = JsonXContent.jsonXContent.createParser(
            registry,
            DeprecationHandler.IGNORE_DEPRECATIONS,
            ByteArrayInputStream(source.toByteArray(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
        )
        var token = parser.currentToken()
        token = parser.nextToken()
        token = parser.currentToken()
        logger.debug("TOKEN:{}", token)
        val sort = SortBuilder.fromXContent(parser)
        logger.debug("SORT:{}", sort)
    }

    @Test
    @Throws(Exception::class)
    fun highlightStringTest() {
        if (TestUtil.launchForBuild()) return

        val source = "" +
            "  { " +
            "    \"number_of_fragments\" : 3, " +
            "    \"fragment_size\" : 150, " +
            "    \"pre_tags\" : [\"<tag1>\"], " +
            "    \"post_tags\" : [\"</tag1>\"], " +
            "    \"fields\" : { " +
            "      \"_all\" : { " +
            "        \"fragment_size\" : 15, " +
            "        \"number_of_fragments\" : 3, " +
            "        \"fragmenter\": \"simple\" " +
            "      }, " +
            "      \"PRODUCTNAME\" : { " +
            "      } " +
            "    } " +
            "  } "
        val parser = JsonXContent.jsonXContent.createParser(
            NamedXContentRegistry.EMPTY,
            DeprecationHandler.IGNORE_DEPRECATIONS,
            ByteArrayInputStream(source.toByteArray(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
        )
        parser.nextToken()
        val highlight = HighlightBuilder.fromXContent(parser)
        for (field in highlight.fields()) {
            logger.debug("FIELD:{}", field.name())
        }
        logger.debug("HIGHLIGHT:{}", highlight)
    }

    @Test
    @Throws(Exception::class)
    fun testAnalyzeDetail() {
        if (TestUtil.launchForBuild()) return

        val index = ""
        val dictionary = TestUtil.loadDictionary()!!
        contextStore.put(ProductNameDictionary.PRODUCT_NAME_DICTIONARY, dictionary)
        var str = ""
        str = "Sandisk Extream Z80 USB 16gb \uC2A4\uC704\uC2A4\uC54C\uD30C\uC778\uD074\uB7FD"
        // str = "nt-ok123"
        var useForQuery = true
        // useForQuery = false
        val useSynonym = true
        val useStopword = true
        val useFullString = true
        var detail = true
        // detail = false
        val stream = getAnalyzer(dictionary, str, useForQuery, useSynonym, useStopword, useFullString)
        val buffer = StringWriter()
        val writer = JSONWriter(buffer)
        ProductNameAnalysisAction.analyzeTextDetailWriteJSON(null, str, stream, index, detail, writer, useForQuery)
        logger.debug("RESULT : {}", buffer.toString())
    }

    @Test
    @Throws(Exception::class)
    fun testFastcatsearch() {
        if (TestUtil.launchForBuild()) return

        val url = "http://192.168.1.1:8090/service/search?cn=TEST&se=NOT{PRODUCTCODE:-1}&fl=ID,BUNDLEKEY,PRODUCTCODE,SHOPCODE,SHOPPRODUCTCODE,PRODUCTNAME,PRODUCTMAKER,MAKERKEYWORD,PRODUCTBRAND,BRANDKEYWORD,PRODUCTMODEL,MODELWEIGHT,PRODUCTIMAGEURL,LOWESTPRICE,MOBILEPRICE,PCPRICE,TOTALPRICE,SHOPQUANTITY,CATEGORYCODE1,CATEGORYCODE2,CATEGORYCODE3,CATEGORYCODE4,CATEGORYKEYWORD,CATEGORYWEIGHT,REGISTERDATE,MANUFACTUREDATE,POPULARITYSCORE,PRODUCTCLASSIFICATION,BUNDLEDISPLAYSEQUENCE,PRODTYPE,DISPYN,WRITECNT,CATEGORYDISPYN,ADDDESCRIPTION,PROMOTIONPRICE,MAKERCODE,BRANDCODE,NATTRIBUTEVALUESEQ"

        val indexer = FastcatMigrateIndexer(url, 0, 1000, "Z:/Documents/workspace/TEST_HOME/test_prod.txt", "euc-kr", "", 0, null)
        indexer.migrateFastcat()
    }
}
